title: Electrek - First drive: 2025 Hyundai IONIQ 5 (2025-02-19)
notes: US 2025: Standard Range 63 kWh, Long Range 84 kWh; peak 257 kW on a 350 kW CCS charger (233 kW in earlier years); 10-80% 24 min (63 kWh) / ~31 min (84 kWh) on a 135 kW NACS V3, ~20 min on a 250+ kW CCS charger for both; NACS port with free CCS adapter.
